items.title: Is Microsoft (MSFT) Building A Bigger AI Role In Scientific Labs?
items.summary: Microsoft (NasdaqGS:MSFT) and Danaher Corporation announced a broad AI partnership focused on laboratory automation and scientific instrumentation in November 2026. The collaboration will use Microsoft Azure and Danaher’s Foundry platform to build interoperable agentic AI systems for lab workflows.
